text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! All those fan letters on your desk are really for me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's eyes light up when she sees the pile of letters addressed to her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You bet! And it's all thanks to your daily guidance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory bows deeply in appreciation before opening the letters and reading them.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Listen to this. "Every time I see you run with such power and passion, my heart starts pounding!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And this one. "Your recent race was so intense! I've never been so excited watching a race before!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's such an honor to get this much praise! And this next one…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "The cheerful way you greet everyone in front of the school gates gives me life! You have my support!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Are they recognizing my role as chair of the disciplinary committee?!
choice_data_list: You are always working hard at it.
You are always working hard at it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: No way. I'm just doing what the position calls for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I want the academy to be a place where our students can learn in peace and chase their dreams! That's what the disciplinary committee is for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't do it for any kind of recognition. Still…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's nice to receive such kind words.
choice_data_list: Keep up the good work, on and off the track!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do what I need to do to keep both the racing fans and the disciplinary committee fans all happy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Which means I need YOU to work me TO THE BONE!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's determined plea resounds through the heavens.
